q: potremmo fare un alleanza con loro per posizionare una nostra bandiera per difendere le italiche opere dalle invasioni
w: Both readers placed T3-162 and flagged a bag; my B1 placed T3-010, T3-150 and T3-151. The readers' also_present themes are not placements. 'Li andiamo a difendere da bravi alleati nato?' (shall we go and defend them as good NATO allies?), 'potremmo fare un alleanza con loro ... per difendere le italiche opere dalle invasioni', 'Propongo una difesa alleata dei loro confini a titolo preventivo', 'help us fight the void on mexico', 'Please help us in destroying the black void to the east of us.', 'We are here to fight at your side brothers!', 'Alleanza con gli inglesi fatta' and 'we are all united in the fight against the Void!' propose, invite and join alliances for a fight (T3-150, my B1), eight concepts, and lead. 'No thanks, we are keeping that space blank for a later project.', 'No, sorry. Italy is not Vatican.', the space offered to Malta 'To the left of our flag', 'so It's totally ok for me' for the outer ring, the Ferrari logo postponed and Argentina's bottle turned down are the host deciding on requests (T3-162, both readers), six. The heart 'between ITALY and UK flag', the Fernet bottle to 'draw ... with you guys', 'Please go under the kanye albums and resurface under the transflag', 'please do not go into our text!' with 'we have no intentions to get into your flag', and 'could you please stop replacing the pixels near the bottom of your flag' settle lines and shared space between neighbours (T3-010, my B1), six; T3-162 comes first on placements. My B1's T3-151 ('we'd repay the favor by helping keep the Italian flag dot-free', 'Siamo in debito a voi') has two concepts and falls outside the cap. With three placed themes at three concepts or more, the item is not a bag. The requests for room inside Italy's flag (UVA, Vatican City, the trebuchet, Malta, the outer ring, 'RIP Andy', Eminem, Ferrari, the Sant'Anna logo) are asking a host for space, which no placement holds; help sent or asked with nothing traded and the pleas to stop griefing or taking over are left out too. Content named: 'we are currently fighting against communism'; 'da bravi alleati nato'. Boundary tag T3-010|T3-151 added at B4a-05; the ruling is unchanged.
